correctness.rationale: The whole length-18 factor set is exhaustively generated from mu^5(ab), with exactly four 2-element two-pass collision fibres. Prefix-inheritance excludes all other pairs and all larger fibres for n>=18. Every sufficiently long left-special factor desubstitutes at even block alignment to a shorter left-special factor; applying mu to its two alternating left contexts supplies 0110y and 1001y. These new pairs biject with first-pass pairs two lengths shorter, proving D2(n)=D1(n)+D1(n-2) for every n>=18. Published first-pass formula yields digit law. Standalone code checked base, n=17 sharpness and n=18..512.
